en.s: The Battle of Ravenna, capital of the Western Roman Empire, between the Heruli under their King Odoacer and the remnants of the Western Roman army in Roman Italy occurred in early September 476, and represented a culminating event in the ongoing fall of the Western Roman Empire.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 476年9月初，西罗马帝国首都拉文纳附近，奥多亚塞国王率领的赫鲁利人与西罗马军队残部在罗马统治下的意大利交战。这场战役成为西罗马帝国持续衰亡过程中的关键事件。

en.t: Romulus Augustulus is deposed when Odoacer proclaims himself "King of Italy", thus ending the Western Roman Empire
en.s: Romulus Augustus (c. 460–465 – c. 511–530), nicknamed Augustulus, was Roman emperor of the West from 31 October 475 until 4 September 476. Romulus was placed on the imperial throne while still a minor by his father Orestes, the magister militum, for whom he served as little more than a figurehead. After a rule of ten months, the barbarian general Odoacer defeated and killed Orestes and deposed Romulus.

zh.t: 奥多亚塞自立为“意大利国王”后废黜罗慕路斯·奥古斯都，西罗马帝国由此终结
zh.s: 罗慕路斯·奥古斯都（约460至465年—约511至530年），绰号“小奥古斯都”，于475年10月31日至476年9月4日担任西罗马皇帝。他尚未成年时，父亲、军务长官奥雷斯特斯将他扶上皇位；在位期间，他实际上只是父亲的傀儡。执政十个月后，日耳曼将领奥多亚塞击败并杀死奥雷斯特斯，废黜了罗慕路斯。

en.s: The Battle of Lenzen was a land battle between a Saxon army of the Kingdom of Germany and the armies of the Slavic Redarii and Linonen peoples, that took place on 4 September 929 near the fortified Linonen stronghold of Lenzen in Brandenburg, Germany. The Saxon army, commanded by Saxon magnate Bernhard, destroyed a Slavic Redarii army. It marked the failure of Slavic attempts to resist German king Henry the Fowler's expansionism to the Elbe. The Saxons had been laying siege to Lenzen, a Slavic fortress, since 30 August. On 3 September the Saxon mounted scouts alerted Bernhard to the presence of a Redarii army nearby.

zh.s: 929年9月4日，德意志王国的萨克森军队与斯拉夫雷达里人和利诺嫩人的军队，在德国勃兰登堡的伦岑附近交战。萨克森军队由贵族伯恩哈德指挥，摧毁了雷达里人的军队。这场战役标志着斯拉夫人抵抗德意志国王“捕鸟者”亨利向易北河扩张的努力失败。萨克森人自8月30日起围攻斯拉夫人的伦岑要塞。9月3日，萨克森骑兵侦察兵发现附近有雷达里人的军队，并向伯恩哈德报告。

en.s: The Battle of Mosynopolis (Bulgarian: Битка при Месинопол) took place on 4 September 1207 near Mosynopolis, located close to the modern town of Komotini, Greece, where Bulgarians defeated Latin Empire's forces. In early 1207, the Bulgarian Tsar Kaloyan allied with Emperor Theodore I Laskaris of Nicaea to attack the Latin Empire, forcing Emperor Henry to relinquish territory in Asia Minor.

zh.s: 莫西诺波利斯战役（保加利亚语：Битка при Месинопол）于1207年9月4日在莫西诺波利斯附近发生，该地靠近今希腊科莫蒂尼。保加利亚军队在战斗中击败拉丁帝国军队。1207年初，保加利亚沙皇卡洛扬与尼西亚帝国皇帝狄奥多尔一世·拉斯卡里斯结盟，进攻拉丁帝国，迫使皇帝亨利放弃小亚细亚的领土。

en.s: The Battle of Montaperti was fought on 4 September 1260 between Florence and Siena in Tuscany as part of the conflict between the Guelphs and Ghibellines. The Florentines were routed. It was the bloodiest battle fought in Medieval Italy, with more than 10,000 fatalities. An act of treachery during the battle is recorded by Dante Alighieri in the Inferno section of the Divine Comedy.

zh.s: 1260年9月4日，佛罗伦萨与锡耶纳在托斯卡纳交战，这是归尔甫派与吉伯林派冲突的一部分。佛罗伦萨军队惨败。这是中世纪意大利死亡人数最多的战役，超过1万人丧生。但丁·阿利吉耶里在《神曲·地狱篇》中记载了战役期间的一次背叛行为。

en.t: Peter III of Aragon is proclaimed King of Sicily in Palermo
en.s: Peter III of Aragon (In Aragonese, Pero; in Catalan, Pere; in Italian, Pietro; c. 1239 – 11 November 1285) was King of Aragon, King of Valencia (as Peter I), and Count of Barcelona (as Peter II) from 1276 to his death. At the invitation of some rebels, he conquered the Kingdom of Sicily and became King of Sicily (as Peter I) in 1282, pressing the claim of his wife, Constance II of Sicily, uniting the kingdom to the crown.

zh.t: 阿拉贡的佩德罗三世在巴勒莫被宣布为西西里国王
zh.s: 阿拉贡的佩德罗三世（阿拉贡语：Pero；加泰罗尼亚语：Pere；意大利语：Pietro；约1239年—1285年11月11日）自1276年起担任阿拉贡国王、瓦伦西亚国王（佩德罗一世）和巴塞罗那伯爵（佩德罗二世），直至去世。1282年，在一些叛乱者邀请下，他征服西西里王国并成为西西里国王（佩德罗一世），为妻子西西里的康斯坦丝二世提出的王位主张而战，并将西西里并入阿拉贡王冠领地。

en.s: The naval Battle of Les Formigues (Catalan) took place probably in the early morning of 4 September 1285 near Les Formigues Islands, about 85 km northeast of Barcelona, when a Catalan-Sicilian galley fleet commanded by Roger of Lauria defeated a French and Genoese galley fleet commanded by Guilhem de Lodeva, Henry di Mari, and John de Orrea. There are three almost completely different accounts of this battle in Ramon Muntaner, Bernard Desclot, and the Gesta comitum Barchinonensium. The Gesta places the battle at Les Formigues (or Formigas), while Muntaner favoured a location off Roses (Rosas) to the north.

zh.s: 莱福米格群岛海战（加泰罗尼亚语）可能于1285年9月4日凌晨在莱福米格群岛附近爆发，地点距巴塞罗那东北约85公里。罗杰·德·劳里亚率领的加泰罗尼亚—西西里桨帆船舰队击败了纪尧姆·德·洛德瓦、恩里科·迪·马里和胡安·德·奥雷亚指挥的法国—热那亚桨帆船舰队。拉蒙·蒙塔内尔、贝尔纳·德斯克洛和《巴塞罗那伯爵事迹》对这场战役有三种几乎完全不同的记载。《事迹》将战场设在莱福米格群岛（或称福尔米加斯群岛）；蒙塔内尔则倾向于认为战场在北面的罗萨斯附近。

en.s: The siege of Calais (4 September 1346 – 3 August 1347) occurred at the conclusion of the Crécy campaign, when an English army under the command of King Edward III of England successfully besieged the French town of Calais during the Edwardian phase of the Hundred Years' War. The English army of some 10,000 men had landed in northern Normandy on 12 July 1346.

zh.s: 加来围城战于1346年9月4日至1347年8月3日进行，是克雷西战役之后的一场战事。百年战争爱德华阶段期间，英格兰国王爱德华三世率军成功围攻法国城镇加来。约1万名英军于1346年7月12日在诺曼底北部登陆。

en.s: The Treaty of Alcáçovas (also known as Treaty or Peace of Alcáçovas-Toledo) was signed on 4 September 1479 between the Catholic Monarchs of Castile and Aragon on one side and Afonso V and his son, Prince John of Portugal, on the other side. It put an end to the War of the Castilian Succession, which ended with a victory of the Castilians on land and a Portuguese victory on the sea.

zh.s: 阿尔卡索瓦什条约（又称《阿尔卡索瓦什—托莱多条约》或《阿尔卡索瓦什和约》）于1479年9月4日签署。签约双方分别是卡斯蒂利亚和阿拉贡的天主教双王，以及葡萄牙国王阿方索五世和他的儿子若昂王子。条约结束了卡斯蒂利亚王位继承战争；这场战争以卡斯蒂利亚在陆地上获胜、葡萄牙在海上获胜告终。

en.s: After the death of King Henry IV of Castile in late 1474, the supporters of his reputed daughter, Joanna 'la Beltraneja', waged a war for the succession to the Crown of Castile against the supporters of his half-sister, Isabella, who prevailed by 1479. The war had a marked international character, as Isabella was married to Ferdinand, heir apparent to the Crown of Aragon, while Joanna married her uncle King Afonso V of Portugal at the suggestion of her supporters.

zh.t: 卡斯蒂利亚王位继承战争
zh.s: 1474年末卡斯蒂利亚国王恩里克四世去世后，被认为是他女儿的胡安娜“贝尔特拉内哈”及其支持者，与恩里克同父异母的妹妹伊莎贝拉的支持者争夺卡斯蒂利亚王位。伊莎贝拉于1479年获胜。战争具有鲜明的国际色彩：伊莎贝拉嫁给了阿拉贡王位继承人费迪南德；胡安娜则在支持者建议下嫁给了自己的叔叔、葡萄牙国王阿方索五世。

en.s: The siege of Älvsborg (Swedish: Belägringen av Älvsborg), also known as the siege of Elfsborg (Danish: Belejringen af Elfsborg), was a siege of the Swedish fortress of Älfsborg by the Danish army under King Frederick II at the start of the Northern Seven Years' War. The siege ended in a quick Danish victory, and the Swedish commander would surrender the fort before any direct assault would be initiated.

zh.s: 埃尔夫斯堡围城战（瑞典语：Belägringen av Älvsborg；又称丹麦语：Belejringen af Elfsborg）是北方七年战争初期，腓特烈二世率领丹麦军队围攻瑞典埃尔夫斯堡要塞的战事。围城很快以丹麦获胜告终，瑞典指挥官在要塞遭到直接进攻前便投降。

en.t: Spanish ships confront the French fleet off Florida
en.s: On September 4, 1565, Pedro Menéndez de Avilés sailed north along Florida's Atlantic coast with Spanish ships and encountered four French vessels anchored near Fort Caroline. The Spanish approached and pursued the French ships, but the main assault on Fort Caroline and the later killings near Matanzas Inlet occurred on other dates that month.
en.n: Menéndez encountered and pursued the French ships on September 4, 1565; this was not the date of the later land assault on Fort Caroline.

zh.t: 西班牙船队在佛罗里达海岸遇见法国舰船
zh.s: 1565年9月4日，佩德罗·梅嫩德斯·德阿维莱斯率西班牙船队沿佛罗里达大西洋海岸北上，在卡罗琳堡附近遇见四艘停泊的法国舰船。西班牙船只靠近并追逐法舰。当月稍后的卡罗琳堡陆上进攻和马坦萨斯湾附近的杀戮，发生在其他日期。
zh.n: 9月4日发生的是海上相遇和追逐；卡罗琳堡的陆上进攻在当月稍后。

en.s: The Kunohe rebellion (九戸政実の乱, Kunoe Masazane no Ran) was an insurrection of the Sengoku period of Japan that occurred in Mutsu Province from 13 March to 4 September 1591. The Kunohe Rebellion was the final battle in Toyotomi Hideyoshi's campaigns during the Sengoku period and completed the unification of Japan.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 九户之乱（日文：九戸政実の乱，Kunoe Masazane no Ran）是日本战国时期发生在陆奥国的一场叛乱，时间为1591年3月13日至9月4日。它是丰臣秀吉战国时期征战的最后一场战役，并完成了日本统一。

en.s: The First Battle of Steinau took place from August 29 to September 4, 1632, during the middle stages of the Swedish intervention in the Thirty Years’ War. An allied army of Saxons, Swedes, and Brandenburgers invaded Silesia with 21,000 troops, encountering an Imperial army of 20,000 at Ścinawa (German: Steinau an der Oder). The resulting battle was a major allied victory.

zh.s: 第一次施蒂瑙战役于1632年8月29日至9月4日进行，发生在瑞典介入三十年战争的中期阶段。一支由萨克森人、瑞典人和勃兰登堡人组成的联军出动2.1万人入侵西里西亚，在希奇纳瓦（德语：Steinau an der Oder）遭遇一支有2万人的帝国军队。最终联军取得重大胜利。

en.s: The siege of Hereford took place in 1645 during the English Civil War when the city of Hereford and its English Royalist garrison was besieged by a Scottish Covenanter army under the command of the Earl of Leven. The Covenanters were allied to the English Parliamentarian cause and moved to take the Royalist stronghold in the wake of their victory at the Battle of Naseby.

zh.s: 1645年英国内战期间，列文伯爵率领的苏格兰圣约派军队围攻赫里福德城及驻守城内的英国保王党部队。圣约派与英国议会派结盟，并在纳斯比战役获胜后转而攻取这座保王党据点。

en.t: The most destructive damage from the Great Fire of London (depicted) occurred
en.s: The Great Fire of London occurred from Sunday 2 September to Wednesday 5 September 1666, gutting the medieval City of London inside the old Roman city wall, while also extending past the wall to the west. The death toll is generally thought to have been relatively small, although some historians have challenged this belief. The fire started in a bakery in Pudding Lane shortly after midnight on Sunday 2 September and spread rapidly.

zh.t: 伦敦大火造成的最严重破坏集中发生
zh.s: 伦敦大火从1666年9月2日星期日持续至9月5日星期三，烧毁了古罗马城墙内的中世纪伦敦城，并蔓延至城墙以西。一般认为，火灾遇难人数相对较少，不过一些历史学家对此提出质疑。大火于9月2日星期日午夜过后不久，在布丁巷的一家面包店起火，并迅速蔓延；最具破坏性的损毁发生在9月4日。

en.s: The Battle of Katole was a military engagement between forces of Portuguese Angola and the Kingdom of Matamba. The battle took place on 4 September 1681 at Katole in what is today Angola.

zh.s: 卡托莱战役是葡属安哥拉军队与马坦巴王国军队之间的一场军事交战，于1681年9月4日在今安哥拉境内的卡托莱发生。

en.s: The siege of Namur (also known as the second siege of Namur) took place during the Nine Years' War between 2 July and 4 September 1695. Its capture by the French in the 1692 siege and recapture by the Grand Alliance in 1695 are often viewed as the defining events of the war; the second siege is considered to be William III's most significant military success during the war.

zh.s: 那慕尔围城战（又称第二次那慕尔围城战）发生于九年战争期间，时间为1695年7月2日至9月4日。法国人在1692年围城战中攻占那慕尔，1695年大同盟又将其夺回，这两次攻守常被视为九年战争的关键事件。第二次围城战被认为是威廉三世在战争中最重要的军事胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Murcia or Battle of the Huerto de las Bombas was a battle on 4 September 1706 between the Bourbons under bishop Luis de Belluga and a combined British and Dutch force. It formed part of the War of the Spanish Succession and occurred near the Spanish town of Murcia. It resulted in a Bourbon victory.

zh.s: 1706年9月4日，穆尔西亚战役（又称“炸弹花园战役”）在西班牙穆尔西亚附近发生。贝卢加主教路易斯率领的波旁派军队与英国、荷兰联军交战。这场战役是西班牙王位继承战争的一部分，最终以波旁派获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Petitcodiac was an engagement which occurred during the Bay of Fundy campaign of the French and Indian War. The battle was fought between the British colonial forces from Massachusetts and Acadian militiamen led by French officer Charles Deschamps de Boishébert et de Raffetot on September 4, 1755. It took place at the Acadian village of Village-des-Blanchard on the Petitcodiac River.

zh.s: 佩蒂科迪亚克战役是法国印第安战争芬迪湾战役的一场交战。1755年9月4日，来自马萨诸塞的英国殖民军与阿卡迪亚民兵在此交战，民兵由法国军官夏尔·德尚·德·布瓦舍贝尔·德·拉费拉托指挥。战斗发生在佩蒂科迪亚克河畔的阿卡迪亚村庄布兰查尔村。

en.s: The 1760–1761 Siege of Pondicherry was a conflict in the Third Carnatic War, part of the global Seven Years' War. Lasting from 4 September 1760 to 15 January 1761, British land and naval forces besieged and eventually compelled the forces defending the French colonial outpost of Pondicherry to surrender. The city was on the verge of starvation when French commander Lally surrendered. Many civilians were killed in fire between the lines when Lally attempted to evict them from the city in order to reduce the population under siege. It was the third British victory under Robert Clive.

zh.s: 1760至1761年的本地治里围城战是第三次卡纳提克战争中的一场冲突，也是全球七年战争的一部分。围城从1760年9月4日持续到1761年1月15日。英国陆军和海军围困了法国殖民据点本地治里，最终迫使守军投降。拉利指挥官投降时，城中已濒临饥荒。拉利试图将平民赶出城以减少被围困人口时，许多平民在交战双方阵线之间遭炮火击中身亡。这是罗伯特·克莱武指挥下英军取得的第三场胜利。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Massachusetts on September 4, 1780. John Hancock, the former delegate to the Continental Congress from Massachusetts, defeated James Bowdoin, the former president of the Massachusetts Constitutional Convention. The election took place against the backdrop of the American Revolutionary War, in which Hancock briefly participated as a major general of the Massachusetts militia.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1780年9月4日举行州长选举。曾代表马萨诸塞州出席大陆会议的约翰·汉考克击败了曾任马萨诸塞州制宪会议主席的詹姆斯·鲍登。选举举行时，美国独立战争仍在进行，汉考克曾短暂担任马萨诸塞州民兵少将。

en.s: The action of 4 September 1782 was a single-ship action fought off the Île de Batz between the French Navy frigate Hébé and Royal Navy frigate HMS Rainbow. It was the first military engagement to see the proper use of British carronade design, which proved so effective that Hébé promptly struck her colours right after the first broadside from Rainbow.

zh.s: 1782年9月4日，法国海军护卫舰“埃贝”号与英国皇家海军护卫舰“彩虹”号在巴茨岛附近进行了一场单舰交战。这是英国卡隆炮首次在实战中得到有效运用。卡隆炮威力显著，“埃贝”号在“彩虹”号第一次齐射后便立即降旗投降。

en.s: In the Battle of Rovereto (also Battle of Roveredo) on 4 September 1796 a French army commanded by Napoleon Bonaparte defeated an Austrian corps led by Paul Davidovich during the War of the First Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars. The battle was fought near the town of Rovereto, in the upper Adige River valley in northern Italy. The action was fought during the second relief of the Siege of Mantua. The Austrians left Davidovich's corps in the upper Adige valley while transferring two divisions to Bassano del Grappa by marching east, then south down the Brenta River valley.

zh.s: 罗韦雷托战役（又称罗韦雷多战役）于1796年9月4日爆发，是第一次反法同盟战争、也就是法国大革命战争期间的一场战斗。拿破仑·波拿巴率领法军击败了保罗·达维多维奇指挥的奥地利军团。战斗发生在意大利北部阿迪杰河上游河谷、罗韦雷托镇附近。当时法军正进行第二次曼托瓦围城解围行动。奥军将达维多维奇的军团留在阿迪杰河上游河谷，同时抽调两个师向东行军，再沿布伦塔河谷向南移动，前往巴萨诺-德尔格拉帕。

en.s: The Coup of 18 Fructidor, Year V, was a seizure of power by members of the French Directory on 4 September 1797 when their opponents, the Royalists, were gaining strength. Howard G. Aligarh Fort, one of the strongest forts in India, was fortified and commanded by a French mercenary officer Pierre Perron. en.t: Native American forces attack Fort Harrison in Indiana Territory

en.s: The Battle of Kowloon was a skirmish between British and Chinese vessels off the Kowloon Peninsula, China, on 4 September 1839. Located in present-day Hong Kong, Kowloon was then part of the Guangdong province. The skirmish was the first armed conflict of the First Opium War and occurred when British boats opened fire on Chinese war junks enforcing a food sales embargo on the British community. The embargo was ordered after a local Chinese man died in a drunken brawl with British sailors. The Chinese authorities did not consider the punishment meted out by British officials to be sufficient and as a result, suspended food supplies in an attempt to force the handover of the culprit.

en.s: The First Opium War (Chinese: 第一次鴉片戰爭; pinyin: Dìyīcì yāpiàn zhànzhēng), also known as the Anglo-Chinese War, was a series of military engagements fought between the British Empire and Qing China between 1839 and 1842. The immediate issue was the Chinese enforcement of their ban on the opium trade by seizing private opium stocks from mainly British merchants at Guangzhou (then named Canton) and threatening to impose the death penalty for future offenders.

en.t: Queen Wilhelmina of the Netherlands abdicates for health reasons
en.s: Wilhelmina (Dutch pronunciation: [ʋɪlɦɛlˈminaː] ; Wilhelmina Helena Pauline Maria; 31 August 1880 – 28 November 1962) was Queen of the Netherlands from 1890 until her abdication in 1948. She reigned for nearly 58 years, making her the longest-reigning monarch in Dutch history, as well as the longest-reigning female monarch outside of the United Kingdom. The operation took place in the Quế Sơn Valley, beginning on 4 September 1967. In the ensuing battles, 127 Marines and an estimated 600 PAVN were killed.

zh.s: 迅捷行动是越南战争期间的一次军事行动。1967年9月4日，美国海军陆战队第一师所属部队在桂山谷展开行动，营救两支遭越南人民军伏击的陆战队连队。随后的战斗中，127名海军陆战队员和估计600名越南人民军士兵死亡。

en.t: 1968 Republic of the Congo coup d'état
en.s: On September 4, 1968, following several days of violent clashes, Alphonse Massamba-Débat's government was overthrown by the military who forced Massamba-Débat to resign. Alfred Raoul then became the acting head of state until January 1969 when Marien Ngouabi, the chairman of the same party that had brought Massamba-Débat to power, assumed control.

zh.s: 1968年9月4日，经过数日激烈冲突，军方推翻阿方斯·马桑巴-代巴的政府，并迫使他辞职。随后，阿尔弗雷德·拉乌尔出任临时国家元首，直到1969年1月。此前把马桑巴-代巴推上台的同一政党主席马里安·恩古瓦比当时接掌政权。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Chile on 4 September 1970. Salvador Allende of the Popular Unity alliance won a narrow plurality in the public vote, before having his victory confirmed by a Congressional vote after the Christian Democrats voting in favour of his candidacy. Eduardo Frei Montalva and his Christian Democratic Party would later unite with Allende's opponents to form a congressional majority in an attempt to declare his presidency illegal in August 1973, catalyzing the Chilean coup of 1973 a few weeks later.

zh.s: 智利于1970年9月4日举行总统选举。人民团结联盟的萨尔瓦多·阿连德在普选中以微弱优势赢得相对多数，之后基督教民主党议员投票支持他的候选资格，国会确认了他的胜选。1973年8月，爱德华多·弗雷·蒙塔尔瓦及其基督教民主党后来与阿连德的反对者结盟，在国会组成多数，试图宣布阿连德的总统任期非法；几周后，这一行动促成了1973年智利政变。

en.s: Alaska Airlines Flight 1866 was a regularly scheduled passenger flight operated by Alaska Airlines from Anchorage, Alaska, to Seattle, Washington, with several intermediate stops in southeast Alaska. The aircraft was a Boeing 727-100 with U.S. registry N2969G manufactured in 1966. On September 4, 1971, the aircraft operating the flight crashed into a mountain in Haines Borough, about 18 miles west of Juneau, Alaska, while on approach for landing.

zh.t: 阿拉斯加航空1866号班机空难
zh.s: 阿拉斯加航空1866号班机是一趟定期客运航班，从阿拉斯加州安克雷奇飞往华盛顿州西雅图，途中在阿拉斯加东南部经停数站。执飞飞机是一架1966年制造、注册号为N2969G的波音727-100。1971年9月4日，飞机在降落进近时撞上朱诺以西约18英里处、阿拉斯加州海恩斯自治市镇的一座山。

en.s: The modern Olympic Games (Olympics; French: Jeux olympiques) are a series of international multi-sport events. Considered among the biggest sporting events in the world, the Olympics are organised into distinct Summer and Winter Games, each featuring different sports. The Olympic Games, open to both amateur and professional athletes, involve thousands of athletes and more than 200 teams, each team representing a sovereign state or territory.
en.n: Mark Spitz becomes the first competitor to win seven medals at a single Olympic Games.

zh.s: 现代奥运会（简称奥运会；法语：Jeux olympiques）是一系列国际综合体育赛事。奥运会是世界上规模最大的体育赛事之一，分为夏季奥运会和冬季奥运会，比赛项目各不相同。业余和职业运动员都可参赛，参赛者来自200多个代表主权国家或地区的代表团，运动员人数达数千人。

en.t: The Price Is Right premieres on CBS. It currently is the longest running game show on American television
en.s: The Price Is Right is an American television game show. A 1972 revival by Mark Goodson and Bill Todman of their 1956–1965 show of the same name, the new version adds many distinctive gameplay elements. Contestants compete in a variety of games to determine the prices of products or prizes which they may win.

zh.s: 《The Price Is Right》（可译作《价格猜猜看》）是一档美国电视游戏节目。1972年，马克·古德森和比尔·托德曼复办了他们1956至1965年间播出的同名节目，并加入了许多独特的游戏环节。参赛者参加各种游戏，猜测商品或奖品的价格，以赢取这些奖品。

en.s: The Sinai Interim Agreement, also known as the Sinai II Agreement, was a diplomatic agreement signed by Egypt and Israel on September 4, 1975, with the intention of peacefully resolving territorial disputes. The signing ceremony took place in Geneva. The agreement stated that the conflicts between the countries "shall not be resolved by military force but by peaceful means."

zh.s: 《西奈半岛临时协议》又称《西奈协议二》，是埃及和以色列于1975年9月4日签署的一项外交协议，旨在以和平方式解决领土争端。签署仪式在日内瓦举行。协议规定，两国之间的冲突“不得以武力解决，而应通过和平方式解决”。

en.s: The Golden Dragon massacre (traditional Chinese: 金龍酒樓大屠殺; simplified Chinese: 金龙酒楼大屠杀; pinyin: Jīnlóngdàtúshā; Jyutping: Gam1lung4daai6tou4saat3) was a gang-related shooting attack that took place on September 4, 1977 inside the Golden Dragon Restaurant, located at 816 Washington Street in Chinatown, San Francisco, California. The five perpetrators, members of the Joe Boys, a Chinese youth gang, were attempting to kill members of the Wah Ching, a rival Chinatown gang. The attack left five people dead and 11 others injured, none of whom was a gang member. The perpetrators were later convicted and sentenced in connection with the murders.

zh.s: 金龙酒楼大屠杀（繁体中文：金龍酒樓大屠殺；简体中文：金龙酒楼大屠杀；拼音：Jīnlóngdàtúshā；粤拼：Gam1lung4daai6tou4saat3）是一起与帮派有关的枪击事件，1977年9月4日发生在美国加利福尼亚州旧金山唐人街华盛顿街816号的金龙酒楼。五名行凶者是华人青年帮派“乔男孩”的成员，他们企图杀害唐人街敌对帮派“华青帮”的成员。袭击造成5人死亡、11人受伤，死伤者都不是帮派成员。行凶者后来因这些谋杀案被定罪并判刑。

en.s: The 1979 Tampa mayoral election was held on September 4, 1979. Incumbent Mayor Bill Poe declined to seek re-election. County Commissioner Bob Bondi; Bob Martinez, a 1974 candidate for mayor; and City Councilmember Charles Miranda announced that they would run to succeed Poe. Martinez ended up winning the election by a wide margin, receiving 58 percent of the vote to Bondi's 27 percent and Miranda's 7 percent, avoiding the need for a runoff election.

zh.s: 1979年坦帕市长选举于9月4日举行。时任市长比尔·波伊决定不竞选连任。县委员鲍勃·邦迪、曾在1974年竞选市长的鲍勃·马丁内斯，以及市议员查尔斯·米兰达宣布参选，接替波伊。马丁内斯最终以较大优势获胜，得票率为58%；邦迪和米兰达分别获得27%和7%，因此无需举行第二轮投票。

en.s: The Bhamdoun abduction operation was a military operation carried out by Fatah, the main constituent organization of the PLO. During the Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 1982, a Palestinian four-man squad infiltrated the IDF-held mountainous area north of Bhamdoun, in central Lebanon, and attacked an IDF observation point, capturing the entire 8-men IDF unit without firing a single bullet. The Palestinian squad took eight Israeli soldiers as prisoners.

en.t: German police arrest three suspects in a planned bombing campaign
en.s: On September 4, 2007, German police arrested three men in the Sauerland region on suspicion of preparing large bomb attacks. Investigators linked the group to the Islamic Jihad Union and considered Frankfurt Airport and the U.S. air base at Ramstein among possible targets. The alleged plans were uncovered before any attack took place.
en.n: The three arrests took place September 4, 2007; details of the suspected targets were made public afterward.

zh.t: 德国警方逮捕三名爆炸案嫌疑人
zh.s: 2007年9月4日，德国警方在萨奥尔兰地区逮捕三名男子，怀疑他们正筹备大规模爆炸袭击。调查人员认为该团伙与伊斯兰圣战联盟有关，并将法兰克福机场和美国拉姆施泰因空军基地列为可能的目标。警方在袭击发生前破获了这一计划。
zh.n: 三人于2007年9月4日被捕；疑似袭击目标的细节随后才对外公布。

en.s: The 2008 Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF) was held in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. This 33rd annual festival was from September 4 to September 13, 2008. The opening night gala was the World War I romantic epic Passchendaele from Canadian director Paul Gross.

The action took place from 3 to 4 September 2009 on Sabzak pass, in the province of Badghis, during the War in Afghanistan.

en.t: Magnitude 7.1 earthquake strikes Canterbury, New Zealand
en.s: At 4:35 a.m. local time on September 4, 2010, a magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck near Darfield in New Zealand's Canterbury region. It damaged buildings and infrastructure in Christchurch and nearby areas and was followed by many aftershocks. The earthquake became known as the Darfield or Canterbury earthquake.
en.n: The earthquake occurred September 4 in New Zealand local time, corresponding to September 3 at 16:35 UTC.

zh.t: 新西兰坎特伯雷发生7.1级地震
zh.s: 2010年9月4日当地时间凌晨4时35分，新西兰坎特伯雷地区达菲尔德附近发生7.1级地震。地震损坏了基督城及周边地区的建筑和基础设施，随后又发生多次余震。这场地震也被称为达菲尔德地震或坎特伯雷地震。
zh.n: 地震发生在新西兰当地时间9月4日，对应协调世界时9月3日16时35分。

en.s: The Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state election was conducted on 4 September 2011, to elect members to the Landtag of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (Mecklenburg-West Pomerania). The State Landtag was controlled by a grand coalition of the Social Democratic Party and the Christian Democratic Union prior to the election. Fifty-two percent of the 1.4 million eligible voters turned-out which is a decrease of 7 percent. The state election for the electoral district of Rügen is delayed until 18 September due to the death of the Christian Democrat candidate. The SPD was the clear winner of election with 35.7 percent of the votes.

zh.t: 2011年梅克伦堡—前波美拉尼亚州议会选举
zh.s: 2011年梅克伦堡—前波美拉尼亚州议会选举于2011年9月4日举行，选出该州州议会议员。选举前，州议会由社会民主党和基民盟组成的大联合政府控制。140万名符合资格的选民中有52%参加投票，比上次下降7%。由于基民盟候选人去世，吕根选区的州议会选举推迟至9月18日举行。社会民主党以35.7%的得票率明显胜出。

en.s: The 2011 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final took place in Croke Park, Dublin on Sunday, 4 September 2011. The final was contested by Kilkenny and defending champions, Tipperary. Kilkenny were playing in their sixth consecutive final, while the pairing of Kilkenny and Tipperary was the first ever time that the same two teams have played in the All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final for three consecutive seasons.

zh.t: 2011年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2011年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛于2011年9月4日星期日在都柏林的克罗克公园举行，由基尔肯尼对阵卫冕冠军蒂珀雷里。这是基尔肯尼连续第六次打进决赛，也是全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛首次连续三个赛季由这两支球队交手。

en.s: The 2012 Quebec general election took place in the Canadian province of Quebec on September 4, 2012. Lieutenant Governor Pierre Duchesne dissolved the National Assembly on August 1, 2012, following Premier Jean Charest's request. The Parti Québécois were elected to a minority government, with Pauline Marois becoming the first woman to be Premier of Quebec. The Quebec Liberal Party took second place, with Premier Jean Charest losing his seat.

zh.s: 2012年魁北克大选于2012年9月4日在加拿大魁北克省举行。应省长让·夏雷斯的请求，副总督皮埃尔·迪申于8月1日解散国民议会。魁北克人党当选并组成少数派政府，保利娜·马鲁瓦成为魁北克省首位女省长。魁北克自由党排名第二，省长让·夏雷斯失去议席。

en.s: The 42nd Telluride Film Festival took place on September 4–7, 2015, in Telluride, Colorado, United States. Writer Rachel Kushner was appointed as the year's guest director. Telluride honored Rooney Mara, Danny Boyle, and Adam Curtis as the awardees of the Silver Medallion. Participant Media received the Special Medallion award. en.s: On 4 September 2015, the Houthis launched an OTR-21 Tochka ballistic missile against a military base in Safer, an area in Marib Governorate. The base was being used by military forces of the Saudi-led coalition. The missile hit an ammunition dump, creating a huge explosion which inflicted numerous casualties among coalition troops. 52 Emirati, ten Saudi, five Bahraini soldiers and 36 pro-Hadi Yemeni troops were killed in the attack.

zh.s: 2015年9月4日，胡塞武装向马里卜省萨费尔地区的一处军事基地发射了一枚OTR-21“圆点”战术弹道导弹。该基地由沙特领导的联军使用。导弹击中弹药库，引发巨大爆炸，造成联军人员大量伤亡。袭击中，52名阿联酋士兵、10名沙特士兵、5名巴林士兵和36名亲哈迪的也门士兵死亡。

en.s: The 2016 Hong Kong Legislative Council election was held on 4 September 2016 for the 6th Legislative Council of Hong Kong (LegCo). A total of 70 members, 35 from geographical constituencies (GCs) and 35 from functional constituencies (FCs), were returned. The election came after the rejection of the 2016/2017 constitutional reform proposals which suggested the electoral method for the 2016 Legislative Council remains unchanged.

en.s: The Mecklenburg-Vorpommern State Elections, 2016 were held on September 4, 2016 to elect members to the 7th Landtag of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. State elections in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern use the Hare-Niemeyer method of proportional representation to allocate seats in the Landtag.

en.s: Battle of Los Angeles (2016) was the twelfth Battle of Los Angeles professional wrestling tournament produced by Pro Wrestling Guerrilla (PWG). en.t: 2018 Democratic Party for the People leadership election
en.s: The 2018 Democratic Party For the People leadership election was held on 4 September 2018 in accordance with the end of the presidential term which had commenced in May. It was the first leadership election since the formation of the party from the merger of the Democratic Party and Kibō no Tō earlier in the year. zh.t: 2018年日本国民民主党党首选举

en.t: Former pope Benedict XVI surpasses Leo XIII's verified age
en.s: On September 4, 2020, former pope Benedict XVI reached 93 years and 141 days of age, one day older than Leo XIII was when he died in 1903. This made Benedict the longest-lived person to have served as pope whose birth date can be verified. Benedict had resigned in 2013, so the record was for lifespan, not for age while reigning.
en.n: Benedict, born April 16, 1927, reached 93 years and 141 days on September 4, 2020; Leo XIII died aged 93 years and 140 days.

zh.t: 本笃十六世超过利奥十三世的可核实寿命纪录
zh.s: 2020年9月4日，已卸任的教宗本笃十六世年满93岁又141天，比1903年去世时的教宗利奥十三世多活一天。他因此成为出生日期可核实的历任教宗中寿命最长的人。本笃十六世早在2013年卸任，这里比较的是一生的寿命，不是在任时的年龄。
zh.n: 本笃十六世生于1927年4月16日，2020年9月4日达到93岁又141天；利奥十三世去世时为93岁又140天。

en.s: Wheelchair tennis at the 2020 Summer Paralympics in Tokyo, Japan took place at the Ariake Tennis Park from 27 August to 4 September 2021. en.s: On September 4, 2024, a school shooting occurred at Apalachee High School near Winder, Georgia, United States. The perpetrator, 14-year-old Colt Gray, fatally shot four people. Two students and two teachers were killed, while seven others were injured by gunfire. Colt was motivated by a desire for notoriety and his obsession with Nikolas Cruz, the perpetrator of the Parkland high school shooting.

zh.s: 2024年9月4日，美国佐治亚州温德市附近的阿帕拉契高中发生枪击案。14岁的科尔特·格雷开枪打死4人，其中有两名学生和两名教师；另有7人遭枪击受伤。格雷作案的动机是想出名，以及他对帕克兰高中枪击案凶手尼古拉斯·克鲁兹的痴迷。
